terminology: labelled representation = (H; l-tuple; 4-tuple of run multisets; y-tuple); its linear word has runs sorted by value. independence: own code from PLAN-v1 Sec. 1-3 definitions; no worker code read, imported, copied or run; the worker plan text (incl. its plan-time counts) was displayed in full by the read tool and the worker avoider list was used only for the final comparison
